records.specification_basis: The official specification and transaxle report identify five forward speeds. The reviewed driving source describes the transaxle as fully synchronized. The direct driving account identifies an H-pattern manual gearbox. The car has a physical triple-plate clutch and H-pattern manual transmission; clutch operation is required to launch from rest. The direct driver account states clutch use on running upshifts. Manual blip is modeled as a downshift action. No upshift blip action applies to this model. The direct driver account states clutch use on running downshifts. Throttle lift is not a separately modeled downshift action here. No downshift cut action is documented. The established synchromesh construction makes manual rev matching useful but optional under the project's derivation. The full-resolution exact 787B cockpit image shows a continuous round three-spoke rim. The digital instruments are mounted on the dashboard ahead of the wheel, not in the rim. No wheel-mounted shift-light strip or lamps are visible on the exact cockpit image. The rim is closed and continuous. The reviewed sources did not establish the remaining technique and wheel fields, which stay unknown in the real-car baseline: /authentic_controls/transmission/shift_pattern, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/throttle_lift, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/automatic_cut, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/automatic_blip.
